headline.text: L3 ML1 was down *4 hours* for C2 belt replacement — back up at 13:19 — while L3 ML4 fought TG belt issues all morning before stabilizing at full speed.

per_plant_summary.L1: L1 ran caramel and cluster lines with two significant mechanical issues that both cleared. S2 enrober bearing failed at 10:21, replacement took 40 minutes and line restarted by 11:50. S3 had a Z-belt wire replacement that caused downstream temper loss; temper regained and line running by 07:41. S1 Matrix 10 had sealing issues through mid-morning, resolved at 09:16 after cleaning and adjustment. S3 MM5 has multiple bucket alignment issues that need maintenance when downtime allows.
per_plant_summary.L2: L2 FFS started with a 17-minute pouch quality stop (top/bottom fold) at 07:32, cleared by 07:49. ML2 had two printer faults — video jet cartridge replacement at 11:56 and a makeup fault at 13:01, both cleared quickly. ML3 replaced a belt before the twin belts at 07:41, swabbed and back up by 07:50. Otherwise clean day.
per_plant_summary.L3: L3 had the heaviest mechanical load. ML1 discovered a brass gasket installed wrong at startup (center pistons not working), corrected by 07:10. C2 belt sensor failed at 08:18, line ran reduced speed until maintenance replaced the belt and corrected bent hardware on C1 and C6; back at full speed 13:19 after 4+ hours down. ML4 started with a depositor screen freeze (fixed by 05:33), then gondola outfeed failure at 06:42 (41 minutes down, power cycle cleared), followed by TG3 and TG5 blue belt issues from 07:32 through 11:30 when all three TGs finally ran at 25 mpm. Truffle Line had two Cavanna 1 issues (belt fraying and chocolate flipping), both cleared by mid-morning, but the temperter is still working incorrectly and M4 belt requires manual guiding.

notes.text: ML1 brass gasket was installed in the wrong position during weekend clean — second similar setup error in two weeks per Chad Stone; review with cleaning crew scheduled.
Unreal trial run on MF Matrix completed successfully — 62 cases (372 pouches) produced, pallet LPN R425360, 14 cases staged for L2 shipment prep.
S3 swecos and magnets were found dirty at start of shift Monday morning — shutdown checklist not fully completed over weekend per Troy Baxter.

resolved.title: S2 enrober bearing failure
resolved.summary: Enrober shut down at 10:21 with bearing completely destroyed and missing balls, emptying chocolate for replacement.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 11:32 — "Fix only took 40min" and enrober tempering; kitchen sent caramel to line at 11:50 (Erandy Garcilazo Ceja, Victor Romero Sr.).

resolved.title: S3 Z-belt wire replacement and temper loss
resolved.summary: Z conveyor wire being replaced at 06:26, after replacement had temper issues and adjustments needed.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 07:41 — "We have temper and the line is running" (Katya Farnsworth).

resolved.title: S1 Matrix 10 cable disconnect, not picking bags
resolved.summary: Matrix 10 not grabbing bags, appeared to have no air at 06:47.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 07:17 — "A cable on Matrix 10 was disconnected, maintenance fixed it" (Victor Romero Sr.).

resolved.title: S3 metal detector not rejecting cards
resolved.summary: Line paused at 07:45 because MD was not rejecting test cards, QA flag.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 08:05 — "Maintenance adjusted MD. Cards scanned and read correctly, line now back in operation" (Ingrid Moreno Angarita).

resolved.title: S1 Matrix 10 sealing issues
resolved.summary: Matrix 10 having sealing issues at 08:20, not all bags sealing properly.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 09:16 — "All the bags are sealing. I cleaned the sealers and adjusted the bag position" (Victor Romero Sr.).

resolved.title: FFS pouches rejected for top/bottom fold
resolved.summary: Line stopped at 07:32 when QA rejected pouches coming out with improper fold geometry.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 07:49 — "Line is up" (Jeffrey Barney). 17 minutes down.

resolved.title: ML3 small belt before twin belts replacement
resolved.summary: Line down at 07:41 for maintenance to replace the small belt before the twin belts.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 07:50 — "Line is back up. Belt was replaced and swab tests were performed, which were successfully passed" (Claudio Tovar).

resolved.title: ML2 video jet printer shut off
resolved.summary: Line down at 11:39 when printer shut off, had to reset and replace ink and makeup cartridges.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 11:56 — "Line is back up" after reset and cartridge replacement (ML2 FW).

resolved.title: ML2 printer makeup fault
resolved.summary: Line down at 12:49 for printer fault, team prepared to swap video jet from ML3.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 13:01 — "Maintenance was able to clear the makeup fault" without swapping printers (Alex Mendoza).

resolved.title: ML1 depositor brass gasket installed wrong, pistons not working
resolved.summary: ML1 center pistons not working properly at startup (06:10), team troubleshooting found brass gasket installed between wrong plates.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 07:10 — "We completed a test after correcting the brass gasket position, and everything is working properly now" (Grey Boscan).

resolved.title: ML4 gondola outfeed belts not moving, system showing 100% full
resolved.summary: Gondola showed 100% full but was not, outfeed conveyors in grey (off), line down at 06:42 waiting for maintenance.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 07:17 — power cycle resolved communication error, gondola working, filling hoppers to restart. 41 minutes down (Nelson Cook, Itzel Chavez).

resolved.title: ML4 TG3 and TG5 blue belt alignment issues
resolved.summary: TG3 and TG5 down with blue belts coming out of position and stopping machines, bent twin belt roller found on TG5, only TG4 running at reduced speed.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 11:30 — TG3 started at 10:30 with intermittent issues, TG5 back at 11:30, line at 25 mpm with all three TGs running (Itzel Chavez).

resolved.title: ML1 C2 belt sensor failure and replacement
resolved.summary: C2 belt sensor not detecting at 08:18, belt stopping on its own, maintenance tried aligner modification but belt had to be replaced along with bent nose guide hardware.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 13:19 — "Line is back up and running" after C2 belt replaced, all bent hardware replaced, C2 tracking connector tightened, C1 and C6 realigned (Rich Brierley, Nathan Ruiz). Over 4 hours down.

resolved.title: ML4 depositor 4 screen frozen at startup
resolved.summary: Depositor 4 screen turned off and frozen, team could not purge the depositor.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 05:33 — Nathan opened back of screen, disconnected and reconnected wire (Itzel Chavez).

resolved.title: Truffle Cavanna 1 infeed belt shifting and fraying
resolved.summary: One of the infeed belts on Cavanna 1 was shifting to one side and leaving material debris, maintenance was busy on ML4.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 07:19 — lead repositioned belt, adjusted scrapers, QA inspected, "belt is no longer fraying" (Grey Boscan).

resolved.title: Truffle Cavanna 1 chocolate flipping on belt transfer
resolved.summary: Chocolate jumping and flipping over when switching belts, landing in wrong space and causing sensor rejects.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 09:27 — "Adjusted pre-insert from 60 to 70. Adjusted insert from 85 to 80. Looking good now" (Shawn Jewkes).

resolved.title: ML4 gondola exit belts jammed with bars
resolved.summary: Bars jammed between the belts and metal at gondola exit, line down at 11:20.

needs_attention.title: S3 MM3 and MM4 bag discharge failure
needs_attention.summary: On MM3 and MM4 at 08:52, bag not coming out and instead falling inside, machine not completing discharge cycle.
needs_attention.status: Troy aware and working on solution as of 08:52, no resolution posted by window close.

needs_attention.title: S3 MM5 multiple bucket alignment and vibration issues
needs_attention.summary: MM5 has mechanical issues on buckets #1 (touching lower bucket), #3 and #4 (touching at bottom), and #14 (bent plate), plus some vibrating plates in wrong locations.
needs_attention.status: Most buckets recalibrated with 600g weights, but buckets #1, #3, #4, and #14 will need maintenance when downtime available (09:32).

needs_attention.title: S2 return conveyors 1, 2, 3 sticky with caramel, need re-clean
needs_attention.summary: During morning inspection return conveyors 1, 2, 3 found very sticky with caramel residue, belts need to be cleaned again.
needs_attention.status: Identified at 11:49 during QA inspection, re-cleaning required, impact discussion pending with Katya.

needs_attention.title: Truffle Line temperter working incorrectly
needs_attention.summary: Temperter flagged as working incorrectly at 08:35, no follow-up resolution in the window.
needs_attention.status: Issue reported at 08:35, no updates or resolution posted by end of window.

needs_attention.title: Truffle M4 belt shifting north, requires manual guidance
needs_attention.summary: M4 belt definitely shifting north at 09:34, operators manually guiding it south until maintenance freed up.
needs_attention.status: Operators manually guiding belt as of 09:34, waiting for maintenance to make permanent adjustment.

needs_attention.title: ML1 dosing head cover sporadic chocolate leak
needs_attention.summary: Chocolate leaking from one of the dosing head covers at 07:45, operator replaced screws with shorter ones in case existing screws prevented proper seal.
needs_attention.status: Screws replaced and area cleaned at 08:13, team monitoring to see if this resolves the sporadic leak (Grey Boscan).
